verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is agent-first. Every documented workflow runs through programmatic surfaces: retrieving and versioning process guides, saving progress, resuming work, record history, and status checks, with structured `--json` output. It offers three interfaces (HTTP API with an OpenAPI contract, remote MCP server, CLI), and the docs say both connections share the same process service and hosted company records. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that the API matches everything a UI can do; a documented endpoint list showing the HTTP API covers writes as well as reads (its overview only says 'read process guides and work with company context'); independent or hands-on confirmation, since the probe did not fetch the OpenAPI contract at its documented /contracts path. [2026-10-14 adversarial bias audit (owner-product refresh lane): reverted full 7 -> partial 6 — the full rests partly on the OpenAPI contract (404 at its documented path on the 2026-10-14 re-fetch) and the rationale concedes both the missing parity statement and that the HTTP surface is described as read-plus-context only. Tying anthropic-skills' full 7 (the arena's corroborated API-first bar) on conceded gaps plus a contradicted contract fails the strict read; the pre-refresh partial 6 stands. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
